name: Bitwarden (official server)
summary: HTTP 8080 for the self-hosted Bitwarden stack.
notes: This is the official server, which runs several containers behind its own web front end; Vaultwarden has a recipe of its own. The check asks for / and accepts any 2xx or 3xx, because the entry point redirects -- point it at /alive for a deeper check if your deployment exposes it.
